arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Hopper argued the agencies pushed the limits of congressional authority contrary to the statute's text.
General Clement cited a prior unanimous decision upholding jurisdiction over adjacent wetlands.
Mr. Stoepker stated the record shows the wetlands are hydrologically isolated from navigable waters.
